sermons.title: Sermon 843 | Effectual Calling—Illustrated by the Call of Abram
Sermon 844 | Justification by Faith—Illustrated by Abram's Righteousness

scripture.verse: "And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness."

sermons.title: Sermon 845 | Consecration to God—Illustrated by Abraham's Circumcision

scripture.verse: "And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect. And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly."
